translations.3961806627626390161: Professional 3D printing and 3D printing on demand
translations.2436642238378322634: We offer professional 3D printing and 3D printing on demand for prototypes, functional parts, and small series. We work with precision, quality materials, and short deadlines, suitable for both individual clients and business projects. Whether you have a ready model or an idea you want to realize, we will assist you at every stage of the process.
translations.8638006637392237086: Let us assist you with your project today, see your ideas come to life.
translations.8588668988647067822: 3D printing is a technology for creating physical objects directly from a digital 3D model. By gradually layering material, a finished part is achieved in a relatively short time, depending on its size and complexity.
translations.2807800733729323301: The method is widely applied in both prototype development and real production in fields such as architecture, industrial design, automotive, aviation, medicine, and creative industries. Our 3D printing services include the production of parts with varying complexity and sizes.
translations.5341966966524318723: One of the main advantages of 3D printing is the freedom of form – it is possible to produce parts with almost unlimited geometry and various sizes. We offer 3D printing of small series, prototypes, and functional parts with high quality.

translations.8239304917462363198: 3D printed coin cards for storing Bulgarian stotinki and Euro coins
translations.8643196683861233480: Discover our collection of 3D printed coin cards, created specifically for storing and displaying Bulgarian coins. Each card is crafted with precision and attention to detail, offering a perfect fit for your coins.
translations.3226495676344565961: Each card is designed with exact dimensions for a perfect fit of the coins
translations.1316023348398185123: Beautiful patriotic designs with the Bulgarian flag and map of Bulgaria

translations.296535942465627951: Coins are held securely in the slots, ensuring safe storage
